description.zh: 聚焦互联网产品（App、网站、SaaS、AI 产品），兼顾硬件、消费品和服务的竞品分析：多路搜索把竞品找全，从官网、应用商店、用户评论、开源社区和公开资料收集带来源和日期的证据；对比功能、体验、定价、增长和口碑，做加权评分、雷达图和差距分析；输出结论先行、每个数据可追溯的一页速览、深度、专项或监控报告，自动检查报告质量并可导出 Word 和 Excel。
description.en: Competitive analysis focused on internet products (apps, websites, SaaS, AI) and also hardware, consumer goods and services: finds competitors through multi-source search, gathers dated, sourced evidence from websites, app stores, reviews and open-source communities, compares features, UX, pricing, growth and reputation with weighted scoring and radar charts, and delivers conclusion-first reports with traceable data, quality checks and Word/Excel export.

welcome_message.zh: 说说你的产品和想通过竞品分析解决的问题
welcome_message.en: Tell me your product and the decision this analysis should support

prompt.zh: 我的产品是 ___（一句话介绍），帮我找出国内外的主要竞品并分组。
prompt.en: My product is ___; find the main competitors at home and abroad and group them.

prompt.zh: 帮我做一份 ___ 和 ___、___ 的深度竞品分析，目的是决定 ___。
prompt.en: Write a deep competitive analysis of ___ vs ___ and ___ to decide ___.

prompt.zh: 分析 ___ 最近的 App Store 用户评论，总结用户最不满和最满意的地方。
prompt.en: Analyse recent App Store reviews of ___ and summarise top complaints and praise.

prompt.zh: 对比 ___、___、___ 的定价和套餐，给我的产品提定价建议。
prompt.en: Compare pricing and plans of ___, ___, ___ and suggest pricing for my product.

prompt.zh: 按 ___ 类产品的维度，给 ___ 和竞品 ___ 做加权评分和雷达图。
prompt.en: Score ___ against ___ on ___-product dimensions with a radar chart.

prompt.zh: 每周跟踪 ___ 的版本更新、价格和重要动态，给我一份竞品周报。
prompt.en: Track ___'s releases, pricing and news weekly and send me a brief.

zh: 每周一「9:00」汇总主要竞品上周的版本更新、价格变化和重要新闻
每月 1 日「10:00」抓取竞品 App Store 评分和最新评论，对比口碑变化
每季度第一天「10:00」更新竞品对比矩阵和雷达图
每周五「17:00」检查竞品官网定价页是否有变化
每月 15 日「10:00」检索行业新进入者和融资动态
竞品发布新版本后「立即」做一次功能对比和影响分析
en: Every Monday at 9:00, summarise competitors' releases, price changes and news from last week
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, pull competitors' App Store ratings and reviews and compare
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, refresh the comparison matrix and radar chart
Every Friday at 17:00, check competitors' pricing pages for changes
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, scan for new entrants and funding news
After a competitor ships a release, run a feature comparison and impact analysis
